</div></div></div><div class="col sqs-col-9 span-9"><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_3_1504604772057_8357"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>KITE</strong>, <strong>WINDSURF</strong> &amp; <strong>WINGFOIL</strong> HOTEL, <strong>MADAGASCAR</strong>, <strong>SAKALAVA</strong> BAY, <strong>DIEGO</strong> SUAREZ</h2><h1 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Kitesurfing</strong>, Windsurfing &amp; WINGFOILING <strong>paradise</strong> in <strong>Madagascar</strong>, <strong>DIEGO</strong> SUAREZ!</h1><h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Kiteboarding,</strong> <strong>FUNBOARDING</strong> &amp; WINGFOILING season runs from MID March to MID DECember.</h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Kitesurfers and Windsurfers choose between mirror flat water or waves on the reef! <strong>KiteParadise</strong>&nbsp;<strong>Madagascar</strong> is a rad <strong>kite, windsurf &amp; wingfoil resort </strong>dedicated to<strong>&nbsp;not only to kitesurf and windsurf but to kitefoiling and wingfoiling as well</strong>. It is<strong>&nbsp;</strong>located on the <a href="https://goo.gl/maps/LCwqMr31Daz" target="_blank">magnificent beach of Sakalava Bay</a>, in the North of <strong>Madagascar</strong>, 20km away from <strong>Diego Suarez&nbsp;</strong>. The <strong>wind</strong> blows from mid-March to late December!</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>The flat spot</strong> is right in front of the hotel;&nbsp;<strong>waves</strong> are on the reef, only 600m away. You get a breathtaking view right from your room onto the <strong>kitespot, embracing Sakalava Bay.</strong>&nbsp;Wake up, dress up and go <strong>kitesurfing</strong>! Here, no rocks, nor coral only white sand!</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Sakalava</strong> Bay is also ideal for <strong>kitefoiling and wingfoiling</strong> when the tide is high to mid-high.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Thanks to its outstanding wind conditions and its stunning beauty, Sakalava Bay has been chosen by the best kitesurfers of the world to be part of the Festikite.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">We offer a variety of sleeping options in <strong>superb suites and bungalows with private bathrooms and terraces,</strong> as well as <strong>“A” shape</strong> <strong>bungalow on the dune facing the forest</strong>.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>From our terrace or from the Madagascar Paradise Lounge</strong>&nbsp;upstairs, be inspired by <strong>Sakalava Bay</strong> legendary beauty, get tanned, join us for a jam, drinks, check out your <strong>drone footages or, </strong>on the <strong>living room TV</strong>, you can watch <strong>extreme sports playlists</strong> or take advantage of the <strong>satellite connection</strong> to watch your favorite sports!</p>
</div>

</div></div><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1719585174915_21976"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Our Wifi is free and the Internet is provided by <strong>Starlink</strong>. This high speed satellite connexion allows <strong>digital nomads</strong> to work seemlessly with a fast 270Mb/s bandwidth!</p><p class="" data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Our <strong>restaurant</strong> and <strong>pizzeria </strong>proposes all kinds of tasty food. Its terrace, located 5m above the sea level, is overlooking the lagoon. You eat with a breathtaking view on the lagoon and the sand bar. Our menu is huge and varied. We don’t propose any full/half pension plan because we want our guests to feel entirely free to eat whatever they want, whenever they want. Thus, you’ll pay only for what you get!<br>No need to carry cash : your drinks and food will be added to your bill at the end of your stay.  </p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Our laundry service is exclusively reserved for our guests. In order to propose maximum comfort and hygiene, we wash your laundry in machine with hot water.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">All guests have a <strong>free access to our massage room and gym</strong> with Finnlo (Hammer) machine.</p>
</div>

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">accommodation for <strong>kitesurf</strong>, <strong>WINDSURF</strong> &amp; <strong>WINGFOIL</strong> LOVERS IN <strong>MADAGASCAR</strong></h2><h1 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Cosy, sustainable,<br>on the spot</h1>
</div>
</div></div><div class="row sqs-row"><div class="col sqs-col-3 span-3"><div class="sqs-block image-block sqs-block-image" data-aspect-ratio="39.037433155080215" data-block-type="5" data-sqsp-block="image-classic" id="block-yui_3_17_2_12_1489217023345_167216"><div class="sqs-block-content">

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>KiteParadise</strong> <strong>MADAGASCAR</strong> is located right on the <strong>WINGFOIL</strong>, <strong>kitesURF</strong> &amp; <strong>WINDSURF</strong> SPOT, facing <strong>sakalava</strong> lagoon, overlooking the <strong>KITE</strong> action on the water.&nbsp;</h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Kitesurfing, Windsurfing &amp; Wingfoiling</strong><br>From kitesurfers and windsurfers, <strong>KiteParadise</strong> <strong>Madagascar</strong> was built with passion for pristine nature, wind, and <strong>kite</strong>. <strong>Sakalava</strong> is a quiet and shallow white sand bay near <strong>Diego</strong> Suarez, North tip of <strong>Madagascar</strong>. Windy all year round, white powdery sand, shallow waters :&nbsp;it's a <strong>kitesurf</strong> &amp; <strong>windsurf, kitefoil &amp; wingfoil</strong> gem.&nbsp;Our comfy <strong>kite</strong> &amp; <strong>funboard</strong> resort aims to build it's own little community, a tribe of fellow <strong>water sports</strong> lovers to share the stoke.&nbsp;</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Accommodation</strong><br>KiteParadise is the only <strong>kitesurf and windsurf </strong>accommodation in <strong>Sakalava</strong> Bay facing the famous sand bar,&nbsp;allowing you to jump straight from your room onto the flat <strong>kite</strong> spot.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">We offer different options of hard material bungalows (no insects!) with private bathroom: our new <strong>Chameleon Suites with mezzanines</strong>, feet on the sand, our <strong>impressive Baobab Suite have direct access to the Lounge terrace</strong> and our <strong>adorable Zebu Bungalows on the dunes</strong>..</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">At KiteParadise Madagascar, you also have the opportunity to be hosted in<strong> “A” shaped Maki Bungalows</strong>, tastefully furnished, facing the superb forest, in a natural space <strong>entirely protected from the wind</strong>.</p><p class="" data-rte-preserve-empty="true" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"></p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;"><strong>Entertainment</strong><br>At night join us in the <strong>The Paradise Lounge</strong>&nbsp;for a jam and drinks.&nbsp;The Paradise Bar is equipped with musical instruments and a sound system, perfect for jams and live bands in the evenings.&nbsp;Our facilities also include a communal terrace on the ground floor that extends the reception and restaurant area inside the building and a panoramic sundeck lounge on the roof of our <strong>kite,</strong> <strong>funboard &amp; wingfoiling</strong> <strong>resort</strong>. We also sell some necessities as there are no shops nearby <strong>Sakalava</strong>. &nbsp;</p>
</div>

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h2 style="text-align:center;white-space:pre-wrap;"><a href="/chameleon-suite">CHAMELEON SUITE</a><a href="/baobab-bungalow"> </a></h2>
</div>
</div></div><div class="sqs-block website-component-block sqs-block-website-component sqs-block-horizontalrule horizontalrule-block" data-block-css="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.horizontalrule/54452080-4324-4e11-8a50-17240ba50545_340/website.components.horizontalrule.styles.css&quot;]" data-block-scripts="[&quot;https://definitions.sqspcdn.com/website-component-definition/static-assets/website.components.horizontalrule/54452080-4324-4e11-8a50-17240ba50545_340/website.components.horizontalrule.visitor.js&quot;]" data-block-type="1337" data-definition-name="website.components.horizontalrule" data-sqsp-block="line" data-website-component-id="yui_3_17_2_1_1645004365554_358284" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1645004365554_358284"><div class="sqs-block-content">

  <hr />
    <style class="transform-overrides-vars"></style>

</div></div><div class="sqs-block html-block sqs-block-html" data-block-type="2" data-sqsp-block="text" id="block-yui_3_17_2_1_1645004365554_359590"><div class="sqs-block-content">
<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>

<div class="sqs-html-content" data-sqsp-text-block-content>
  <h3 style="white-space:pre-wrap;">When you chose to stay with <a href="https://goo.gl/maps/LCwqMr31Daz">KiteParadise MADAGASCAR</a> you'll be <strong>kitesurfing</strong> <strong>WINGFOILING</strong> &amp; <strong>WINDSURFING</strong> with a cause.</h3><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">We are big advocates for sustainability and run<strong> 100% on solar energy. KiteParadise</strong> water comes from our <strong>own wells</strong> behind the dune. The water it is still slightly salted.&nbsp;</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">Our <strong>wingfoil,</strong> <strong>kitesurf</strong> &amp; <strong>windsurf ecolodge </strong>is a hard structure covered with <strong>native materials of Madagascar </strong>such as baobao (sort of bamboo) and falafy (dry leaves) to blend perfectly with the surroundings.</p><p class="" style="white-space:pre-wrap;">By cleaning the bay and <strong>planting natives</strong> to stabilise the dunes, we are committed to preserve this <strong>wingfoiling</strong>, <strong>kitesurfing</strong> and <strong>windsurfing</strong> paradise.&nbsp;</p>
